data.value: Partitions are read straight from the image, sparse or not, and every metadata checksum is verified. Each one is saved as name.img in a folder next to the image.

data.value: Converting to raw rebuilds the full image (all parts together) and verifies any CRC-32 it carries. Splitting makes parts fastboot can flash one by one.

data.value: Converting to sparse stores repeated blocks as one record, the format fastboot and factory images use. The output matches AOSP img2simg byte for byte.

Flash it only with the image made for this exact phone, and keep a backup of the current one.
